headline: Steven Gerrard says Man City must be stripped of titles after guilty verdict: 'Make them suffer'
description: Steven Gerrard has said that Manchester City "have to be stripped" of their titles after the club were found guilty of 100+ charges of financial misconduct by the Premier League.

headline: 'Never happened in seven years!' - Arteta confirms double injury blow
description: 'Never happened in seven years!' - Arteta confirms double injury blow

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye Hull GK as Alisson successor
description: Liverpool are looking at Hull City GK Konstantinos Tzolakis, while Man United are interested in Fulham teenager Josh King. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Mikel Arteta defends Arsenal after Piero Hincapié, Martin Zubimendi injuries
description: Mikel Arteta has defended Arsenal's training programme after confirming Piero Hincapié and Martín Zubimendi suffered "far from ideal" injuries in a post-match session on Saturday.

headline: Man City win at angry Anfield; Mourinho overshadows ugly Madrid win
description: Despite the pregame vitriol and ongoing scandal, it was no surprise that Man City won at Liverpool on Sunday. PLUS: Real Madrid won ugly and Mourinho got up to his old tricks after Vinicius' red card.

headline: Football braces for Independent Football Regulator's 'State of the Game' report
description: A landmark report examining the financial sustainability of English football will be published on Tuesday.
